"""Print the size and SHA-256 of a file as JSON. Usage: python scripts/digest.py --file PATH"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--file", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
data = Path(args.file).read_bytes()
print(json.dumps({"file": args.file, "bytes": len(data), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}))
"""Print a small JSON report for a name. Usage: python scripts/report.py --name NAME"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--name", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
print(json.dumps({"name": args.name, "length": len(args.name),
                  "checksum": hashlib.sha256(args.name.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]}))
"""Print a URL slug for a title as JSON. Usage: python scripts/slug.py --title TITLE"""

import argparse
import json
import re

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--title", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
print(json.dumps({"slug": re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", args.title.lower()).strip("-")}))

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from app.services import users
+
+_MAX_EXPR_LEN = 100
+_DECIMAL_DIGITS = frozenset("0123456789")
+
+
+class _InvalidExpression(ValueError):
+    """Raised when the input is not a valid arithmetic expression of the allowed form."""
+
+
+def _tokenize(expr: str) -> list[tuple[str, object]]:
+    """Turn an expression into a list of ("num", int) and ("op", str) tokens."""
+    tokens: list[tuple[str, object]] = []
+    i = 0
+    length = len(expr)
+    while i < length:
+        ch = expr[i]
+        if ch.isspace():
+            i += 1
+        elif ch in _DECIMAL_DIGITS:
+            j = i
+            while j < length and expr[j] in _DECIMAL_DIGITS:
+                j += 1
+            tokens.append(("num", int(expr[i:j])))
+            i = j
+        elif ch in "+-*/()":
+            tokens.append(("op", ch))
+            i += 1
+        else:
+            raise _InvalidExpression()
+    return tokens
+
+
+class _Parser:
+    """Recursive-descent parser: * and / bind tighter than + and -."""
+
+    def __init__(self, tokens: list[tuple[str, object]]) -> None:
+        self._tokens = tokens
+        self._pos = 0
+
+    def _peek(self) -> tuple[str, object] | None:
+        if self._pos < len(self._tokens):
+            return self._tokens[self._pos]
+        return None
+
+    def _advance(self) -> tuple[str, object] | None:
+        token = self._peek()
+        if token is not None:
+            self._pos += 1
+        return token
+
+    def parse(self) -> int | float:
+        if not self._tokens:
+            raise _InvalidExpression()
+        value = self._expr()
+        if self._pos != len(self._tokens):
+            raise _InvalidExpression()
+        return value
+
+    def _expr(self) -> int | float:
+        value = self._term()
+        while True:
+            token = self._peek()
+            if token is not None and token[0] == "op" and token[1] in ("+", "-"):
+                self._advance()
+                rhs = self._term()
+                value = value + rhs if token[1] == "+" else value - rhs
+            else:
+                return value
+
+    def _term(self) -> int | float:
+        value = self._factor()
+        while True:
+            token = self._peek()
+            if token is not None and token[0] == "op" and token[1] in ("*", "/"):
+                self._advance()
+                rhs = self._factor()
+                if token[1] == "*":
+                    value = value * rhs
+                else:
+                    if rhs == 0:
+                        raise ZeroDivisionError()
+                    value = value / rhs
+            else:
+                return value
+
+    def _factor(self) -> int | float:
+        token = self._peek()
+        if token is not None and token[0] == "op" and token[1] == "-":
+            self._advance()
+            return -self._factor()
+        return self._primary()
+
+    def _primary(self) -> int | float:
+        token = self._advance()
+        if token is None:
+            raise _InvalidExpression()
+        if token[0] == "num":
+            return token[1]  # type: ignore[return-value]
+        if token[0] == "op" and token[1] == "(":
+            value = self._expr()
+            closing = self._advance()
+            if closing is None or closing[0] != "op" or closing[1] != ")":
+                raise _InvalidExpression()
+            return value
+        raise _InvalidExpression()
+
+
+def _evaluate(expr: str) -> int | float:
+    return _Parser(_tokenize(expr)).parse()
+
+
+def handle_calc(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    if not isinstance(params, dict):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid expression"}
+    expr = params.get("expr")
+    if not isinstance(expr, str) or len(expr) > _MAX_EXPR_LEN:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid expression"}
+    try:
+        result = _evaluate(expr)
+    except ZeroDivisionError:
+        return 400, {"error": "division by zero"}
+    except _InvalidExpression:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid expression"}
+    if isinstance(result, float) and result.is_integer():
+        result = int(result)
+    return 200, {"result": result}
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user

]
